messages:
noah patel: Day 2 here — I can log into Okta and my Google account (noah@redwood.com) exists, but when I open a shared Drive link I get 'You don't have access to this folder'. Also tried 1Password with the company email and it says 'We can't find an account with that email'. Anyone know which team to ping?
provisioning-bot: Automated: account_creation complete for noah@redwood.com; 1Password invite sent to noah.patel+redwood@gmail.com. If you didn't receive it, request resend via #it-help.
jordan: @noah welcome! Quick check: are you signing into Drive with noah@redwood.com or an alias? We sometimes provision both primary and alias addresses which affects group ACLs. Also paste the exact 1Password error if you can.
noah patel: Using noah@redwood.com. 1Password error is 'We can't find an account with that email'. No invite in spam. Drive link shows folder id in URL and 'Access denied'.
jordan: Drive permissions are applied via Google groups (pm, pm-leads, onboarding). Your profile shows membership in 'pm' but not 'pm-leads' which the kickoff folder requires. I'm adding you to pm-leads now and will force an ACL refresh. For 1Password, provisioning shows we sent to the + address. Can you confirm which personal email got the invite?
noah patel: The invite actually went to noah.patel+redwood@gmail.com (I usually use noah.patel@gmail.com). I asked provisioning-bot to resend to my primary personal address.
provisioning-bot: 1Password invite resend requested to noah@gmail.com. Human approval required (domain mismatch).
eva: @jordan can you check device enrollment? We block some SSO flows for unmanaged devices. Noah, what's the device ID from the enrollment email?
noah patel: Device enrolled yesterday (MacBook Pro 14, device id ends with -A2F3). Okta sign-in worked so figured device is fine. Drive still denied after the group add though.
jordan: I just added you to pm-leads and triggered a Drive ACL refresh. Try the link again and confirm.
noah patel: Working now 44c I can see the PM kickoff folder. The 1Password invite arrived after the resend and I was able to accept. Quick MFA question: 1Password asked me to register a passkey or add a security key. Trying to add my YubiKey on Safari gives 'security key not supported'. Any advice?
linda: For Safari that can happen on certain macOS versions. Workarounds: 1) use Chrome to register the YubiKey (Chrome has more consistent U2F/passkey support), 2) enable security key flags in chrome://flags if it's an edge case, or 3) create a passkey with Touch ID as a fallback and add the YubiKey from another machine. If you're on a corporate image check System Settings privacy permissions for input devices.
noah patel: Switched to Chrome and the YubiKey registered fine. Thanks! One last thing 914 who handles calendar display names and alias sync (noah.patel vs noah)? I want calendar invites to show my full name and prefer the noah.patel alias for external mail.
maria: Calendar/alias changes go through #it-help with HR ticket HR-7890. Ping us there and include the preferred alias + display name; we'll sync Workspace aliases and group membership. Welcome to the team :tada:
